LESSON: WRITING 10.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you organise your thoughts in clear sentences and paragraphs? 2. How can you tell others about yourself?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the parts of a descriptive composition for self-expression,
2. organise thoughts clearly, precisely and creatively into a coherent paragraph for self- expression,
3. create a descriptive composition of about 80- 100 words on various topics for effective communication,
4. promote the role of creativity in descriptive writing for effective communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing.
2. Explain Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read a sample descriptive composition of about 80-100 words with peers and identify the paragraphs,
4. Show that you can: describe the parts of a descriptive composition for self-expression,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you organise your thoughts in clear sentences and paragraphs? 2. How can you tell others about yourself?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
